description: Three-phase multifunction meter: voltages, currents, powers, power factors, frequency, energies, demands, THD and individual harmonics up to the 31st, and settings
source: Selec, MFM384 Series Operating Instructions, OP620-V01, Modbus register addresses list
notes: Modbus RTU on RS485, communication models (-C) only. Slave ID 1 to 255; baud rate, parity and stop bits are settings 8-10.
Addresses are protocol addresses: the manual lists them as 30000/40000 with the protocol address in hex (30000 = 0x00).
Measured values are 32-bit floats in input registers; the manual does not say which word comes first, so check the word order on the device. Settings are 16-bit integers in holding registers.

Individual harmonics: address = 143 + (harmonic - 2) x 2 + 60 x parameter (0-5 voltages V1N, V2N, V3N, V12, V23, V31; 6-8 currents I1, I2, I3). The manual does not state the highest harmonic; this map lists harmonics 2 to 31, which fill each 60-register block up to the serial number at 684. Harmonic addresses are odd, as the formula gives.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: CT primary
registers.description: 5 to 10000 A (1 to 10000 A with a 1 A secondary)

registers.name: Pulse duration
registers.description: 0.1 to 2 s; the manual gives no register encoding

registers.name: Pulse weight
registers.description: 0.01 to 99.99 kWh; the manual gives no register encoding
